text:
Priya M.: FYI Globex enabled log export during the POC and started getting intermittent 429s + a bunch of 502s reported by their sidecar. Can SRE + solutions take a look?

Tom (Globex): We flipped on the drain and saw a traffic spike. Sidecar logs show both 429 and occasional 502 Bad Gateway: 
```
2026-06-12T09:03:12Z level=error code=429 msg=\"throttled\" req=xyz-987 trace=6f2a1b endpoint=/v1/export
2026-06-12T09:03:14Z level=error code=502 msg=\"upstream reset\" req=xyz-988 trace=6f2a1c
```
We send compressed batches (~800 events) using --compressed curl.

Export Bot: Alert: export-gateway-backpressure for project `globex-poc` - avg 5m 429s=950 rps, 502 spikes detected.

Aiden S.: Two quick suspects: 1) batch size + concurrency > gateway window, 2) missing `Content-Encoding: gzip` or chunked transfer mismatch causing upstream to drop connection => 502. What producer are you using?

Tom (Globex): Our k8s init sidecar is a custom uploader; we call: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://export.redwood.com/v1/drain \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  --data-binary @batch.json.gz --compressed
```
We gzip the file locally first.

Liam (SRE): Ah — `--compressed` tells curl to accept compressed responses, not to set Content-Encoding on the request. If you're uploading gzipped body, you must set `Content-Encoding: gzip` header. Without it some proxies try to parse body as JSON and error -> 502. That plus large batch explains the 429 tail. Recommend: set batch_size=300, max_concurrency=3 and add header `Content-Encoding: gzip`.

Carlos (Solutions): Also, Datadog trace correlation needs B3 or W3C headers forwarded. Their sidecar isn't adding `traceparent` so logs lack trace mapping. We have a small snippet for the uploader to add the header from the app req id: 
```
-H \"X-Request-ID: $REQ_ID\" \
-H \"traceparent: 00-${TRACE_ID}-01\"
```
We can also add `dd-trace-id` when talking directly to Datadog.

Nia (Security): Security oversight: the batches include `user.email` and `session.ip` — Globex asked for hashed emails for export. Provide example of in-flight masking (sha256) and company policy alignment. Example with openssl: 
```
jq '.user.email |= \"sha256:\" + (.|tonumber? // .) ' batch.json | \
  while read; do echo \$(echo -n \"$email\" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); done
```
I'll tidy that into a reproducible script and the sec questionnaire answers.

Aiden S.: Proposed immediate mitigation: switch exporter to uncompressed JSON uploads with header `X-Request-ID`, batch_size=300, concurrency=2. Add `Content-Encoding: gzip` only if uploader sets header correctly. On our export gateway I pushed a temporary bump in the soft quota and enabled header passthrough for `traceparent` and `x-request-id` for `globex-poc`.

Liam (SRE): I also applied a temporary export_rate_limit=900 and enabled 5m elevated-burst for the POC window (ticket POC-2071). Monitoring: https://console.redwood/internal/exports/globex-poc (internal).

Tom (Globex): Made the change to send plain JSON (no gzip) and reduced batch to 300, max workers=2. After that the 429s dropped to near zero and the 502s disappeared. Trace links now show up in the console (trace id e.g. 6f2a1b). Thanks!

Priya M.: Sales note: include 1GB/day of export egress for the POC in the quote; if they move to Dedicated we need to account for sustained egress and apply egress add-on. I'll follow up with pricing details.

Nia (Security): I'll upload the sanitized export script and the security answers (data retention, KMS usage, field-level scrubbing) to the ticket.

Export Bot: Ticket POC-2071 status -> mitigated (owner Liam).

Carlos (Solutions): I'll send a short sidecar example for Globex (env vars + curl) and a snippet to auto-populate `traceparent` from their app headers.

Priya M.: Next steps: Carlos to send sidecar snippet, Nia to attach sec scripts, Liam to monitor 24h, I'll confirm pricing line. Tom, any other issues? :thumbsup:

Tom (Globex): All clear for now. Will reopen if anything else shows up.

Priya M.: Thanks everyone, closing the swarm for now. :rocket:
